care.title: Laundry care guide
care.subtitle: Quick, practical tips to keep your clothes looking new.
care.intro: From rainy-season mud to office coffee spills, here is how to treat common stains before they set.

tips.title: Act fast, blot — don't rub
tips.body: Blot the stain with a clean cloth from the outside in. Rubbing pushes it deeper into the fabric.

tips.title: Grease and oil
tips.body: Sprinkle a little cornflour or talcum on the stain to absorb the oil, then brush it off before washing.

tips.title: Coffee and tea
tips.body: Rinse with cool water and dab with a mild detergent. Hot water can set the stain, so keep it cool.

tips.title: Mud and rainy-season splashes
tips.body: Let the mud dry completely, brush off what you can, then wash as normal with a good detergent.

tips.title: Ink marks
tips.body: Dab with a little rubbing alcohol on a cotton bud, working from the edge of the mark inwards.

tips.title: Silk, sarees and delicate fabrics
tips.body: Don't risk it — send these to us for professional dry cleaning and we'll handle them safely.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Just send us a WhatsApp message. Tell us your address and what you need cleaned — we handle the rest.

items.question: Do you offer free pickup and delivery?
items.answer: Yes. Pickup and delivery are free for orders over Rs. 2,500 within our Nugegoda service area.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: Standard service takes about 24 hours. Express 24-hour service is available for urgent orders.

items.question: How is the price calculated?
items.answer: Everyday laundry is priced per kilogram. Separate items like suits, sarees and duvets are priced per item.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: Cash on delivery, bank transfer, or mobile payment. We will confirm when we collect your order.
